selectedRules.verdictBoundary: Executable ${game.executableVersion} synchronizes physical candidate ${game.rulesVersion} and records either the Default Game or Advanced Play profile in every result and replay identity. The Default Game is a new mechanical baseline: historical full-rules results do not establish its balance, negotiation quality, or teachability. The engine retains fresh-seed-validated deterministic profiles, full AGI-funnel and faction-value instrumentation, common-seed comparisons, configuration-specific three/four/five-player inference, causal supplier attribution, non-binding negotiation promises, provider provenance, write-only fresh decision capture, read-only replay, integrity checks, and disabled deferred modules. Simulation cannot prove human balance, negotiation quality, physical teachability, or memorable betrayal.
